answer: Each agent stakes 70 credits at a mesa checkpoint, then clears three challenges, one per epoch. Each link is a lantern signal only its key signs in 10 minutes. A juniper auditor replays the chain, burning the bond on a missed link, reused answer, or borrowed key. Link one costs 40; fake k pays 40+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented answers fail: wrong key, late. Honest agents pay 40 once, keep their bond.
